s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of multiple asymptomatic skin nodules with slow progression
salient_findings: Multiple skin-colored nodules over neck, trunk, and upper limbs
Nodules are discrete, firm, and freely mobile
Single firm nodule on the lateral tongue
key_facts: 55-year-old man
Asymptomatic skin nodules for 1 year
Nodules have slowly increased in size and number
No systemic complaints, including no fever, weight loss, or neurologic symptoms
Eats beef, denies consumption of pork
No passage of tape-like worms in stool
Normal vital signs
Unremarkable general and systemic examinations
No lymphadenopathy
Normal complete blood count and metabolic profile
Nonreactive serologic tests for HIV, hepatitis B, and hepatitis C viruses

shortlist.label: Neurofibromatosis type 1
shortlist.why_kept: Multiple asymptomatic skin nodules and a nodule on the tongue are consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Lipoid proteinosis
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by asymptomatic skin nodules and can involve the tongue

shortlist.label: Multiple lipomas
shortlist.why_kept: Fits with the description of discrete, firm, freely mobile nodules

shortlist.label: Dermatofibromas
shortlist.why_kept: Could explain the skin-colored nodules, although typically they are solitary

shortlist.label: Fibromatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Can present with multiple firm nodules, though often more aggressive

raw.rationale: The patient presents with multiple asymptomatic, skin-colored nodules that are discrete, firm, and freely mobile, which is consistent with the characteristics of lipomas. The slow increase in size and number of the nodules over time also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Neurofibromatosis type 1
rejected.why: Typically associated with cafe-au-lait spots, neurologic symptoms, and other systemic manifestations, which are not present in this case

rejected.label: Lipoid proteinosis
rejected.why: Characterized by a distinctive hoarseness of voice and other systemic symptoms, which are not mentioned in the vignette

rejected.label: Dermatofibromas
rejected.why: Typically present as single or few lesions, often with a history of trauma, and are not usually multiple and widespread like in this case

rejected.label: Fibromatosis
rejected.why: Often associated with aggressive growth, pain, and other systemic symptoms, which are not present in this case
